title: Best eLearning Video Producers (2026): How to Hire One
description: How to hire an eLearning video producer for online courses and training: what to include, formats, accessibility, price factors and red flags.
intro: eLearning video producers create videos for online courses, employee training and educational content. They combine slides, animation, screen recordings and presenter footage to teach clearly. Projects go wrong when lessons are too long, the videos do not work in your course platform, or accessibility is forgotten. This guide helps you produce videos that learners can follow and finish.

faq.q: How long should each lesson video be?
faq.a: Short, focused videos on one topic are easier to follow and update than long lectures. Split courses into bite-sized lessons.

faq.q: Which formats does my course platform need?
faq.a: Most accept MP4, but check resolution, file size and whether captions are separate files. Share your platform's requirements.
